**sdd/issue-239-a3/spec**

**What**: SDD spec delta for A3 (#239), 6 requirements.
**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-239-a3/spec.md.
**Requirements**: REQ-A3-1 labelEvents provider-agnostic verb, normalized shape `[{actor:{login},action:'add'|'remove',label,at}]|null`, ascending order, no leaked provider fields. REQ-A3-2 GitHub inline fetch EXTRACTED behavior-preserving (delete defaultFetchLabeledEvents, keep --paginate, actor-check.test.mjs unchanged). REQ-A3-3 actor-check dispatches on ctx.provider via getVcs; evaluateActor UNCHANGED; GitLab self-approval → fail (not permanent warn); job DETECTION/allow_failure reports never blocks; null/empty → warn (REQ-L5-2). REQ-A3-4 GitLab prView/mrCreate real over gitlabApiFetch, config via params, no direct pipeline-env read (GATE_FILE), normalized shapes, never throws. REQ-A3-5 one shared parameterized contract suite, parity=same assertions, no live network. REQ-A3-6 committed recording script, fixtures stamped endpoint+date, synthetic=DERIVED, provenance always visible (lesson #12).
